note: with 60 geos the study can only detect a 3.3 point change; detecting the 2.0 point target needs 159 geos, or pre-period adjustment at rho>=0.79 -- and a geo's own retention history correlating that well with its next four weeks is an assumption to check, not to assume. The 54,000 users per week are irrelevant to the power; the effective n is the geo count.
what_it_cannot_do: a geo holdout measures the effect of TURNING PAID SEARCH OFF, which is the decision-relevant quantity but is not the same as the effect of a paid-search user being a paid-search user. Organic pickup means the two differ, and the holdout measures the one worth knowing.
